# list all cable txt files for current year
resp = apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path='~/bills/', access_token=token, recursive=True, entry_type='files', substring=f'cable/{current_year}-')
paths = [p for p in resp if p.endswith('.txt') and '/bills/cable/' in p]
paths = sorted(paths)

# parse Total Amount
amounts = []
for p in paths:
    content = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=p, access_token=token)['content']
    m = re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*\n?', content)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError(f'No Total Amount found in {p}')
    amt = float(m.group(1))
    amounts.append((p, amt))

print('amounts', [(p.split('/')[-1], a) for p,a in amounts])

total = sum(a for _, a in amounts)
print('cable_bills_total_this_year', total)
